plugins.contactsPermission: Homecoming uses your contacts to help you choose guardians for your journeys.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Homecoming uses your location to track your journey and share it with your guardians while the app is open.

plugins.cameraPermission: Homecoming uses your camera to capture photo and video evidence for incident reports.
plugins.microphonePermission: Homecoming uses your microphone to record audio with incident videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Homecoming uses your photo library so you can attach existing photos to an incident report.

plugins.motionPermission: Homecoming uses motion data to detect a shake gesture for the emergency alert.
